excerpt: Plan an Ajman apartment sale from ownership documents and pricing through mortgage release, clearance, transfer and handover.
introduction:
Selling an apartment in Ajman starts with the exact unit's ownership and financial position. Gather the title or applicable registration, check any mortgage and building obligations, and agree a process for marketing and transfer. A buyer's offer becomes a completed sale only when the required steps and registration have been completed.

The sequence can differ for a ready unit, a mortgaged property or an off-plan contract. Confirm the current requirements with the land department, developer and lender before signing or accepting money.
takeaways: Check title, seller authority, any mortgage, tenancy and outstanding building charges before marketing.
Agree the price and responsibilities in writing, including clearance, transfer and the treatment of deposits.
Obtain a bank settlement quote where relevant and verify the completed registration and handover.

sections.heading: 1. Gather the unit's documents
sections.body:
Locate the title deed, ownership certificate or applicable initial registration, the unit plan and identification of the owners. If a representative will sign, check the required authority and whether it covers the transaction. Ask the developer or management for the current service-charge statement and clearance requirements.

Identify any mortgage and request a dated settlement statement from the lender. If a tenant occupies the apartment, review the lease, deposit and applicable notice obligations before making promises about vacant possession. Ask a qualified adviser about any uncertainty.

The [Ajman sale registration service](https://www.ajman.ae/en/servicecatalog/services/3162) lists the documents and process, including developer clearance for real estate units. Confirm current requirements and property-specific fees with the department.

rows: Title or initial registration and unit plan
Identify the seller's registered interest and exact property
Seller identity and any authority to sign
Identify obligations to settle before transfer
Plan how a registered mortgage will be discharged
Clarify the tenancy and handover obligations

sections.heading: 2. Price and prepare the apartment
sections.body:
Review recent completed sales of comparable apartments where evidence is available, using the same building, size, condition, view and parking where possible. Compare asking prices with completed sales of similar properties. The [Ajman apartment valuation guide](/journal/how-to-estimate-the-market-value-of-an-ajman-apartment) explains how to compare evidence and when to obtain a professional valuation.

Decide whether practical repairs or cleaning would help a buyer inspect the property. Record defects accurately and do not describe features or availability that cannot be substantiated. Agree the marketing scope, commission and term in writing with an appropriately licensed broker.

The [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026) provides wider neighbourhood context, but the specific apartment's documents and condition matter to its value.

sections.heading: 3. Agree the offer and obligations
sections.body:
Once a buyer is identified, confirm that the buyer can acquire the relevant right in this unit. Record the agreed price, any deposit, inclusions, target transfer date and each party's responsibilities for fees and clearance. Specify what happens if a required condition is not met, and seek legal advice if the wording is unclear.

Check the status of the tenancy and any loan before promising a completion date. For an off-plan interest, ask the developer and authority about the applicable registration, resale restrictions, instalments and clearance; do not assume the process is identical to a completed apartment.

Use traceable payment arrangements and verify instructions directly with the authorised parties. Retain receipts and a copy of the signed agreement.

sections.heading: 4. Settle obligations and register transfer
sections.body:
If a mortgage exists, agree the settlement and release sequence with the bank and the other parties. Ajman's [mortgage release service](https://www.ajman.ae/en/servicecatalog/services/3205) describes a bank-led release process and currently lists AED 500 for release registration and AED 350 for issuing the relevant document. Check the current charge and whether additional bank costs apply to your case.

Obtain required developer clearance and settle agreed outstanding amounts. Confirm the appointment or digital steps with the department and ensure the registered unit and parties match the documents. Do not hand over keys or treat the sale as completed merely because a deposit has been paid.

After registration, obtain the relevant confirmation and reconcile the sale proceeds, loan settlement, agreed fees and any tenant deposit. Arrange keys, access cards and meter readings according to the agreement.

sections.heading: Estimate the proceeds before accepting an offer
sections.body:
Suppose a sample sale is AED 600,000, an outstanding loan settlement is AED 300,000, selling commission is AED 12,000, clearance-related costs are AED 1,000 and agreed repairs cost AED 2,000. The estimated amount remaining is AED 285,000 before other fees or taxes. These example inputs show how sale proceeds can be allocated across the transaction.

The chart shows how the single example is allocated. Request actual dated quotes, include any early-settlement charge and confirm who pays each expense. The result is cash after the stated costs, not a calculation of profit because the original purchase cost is not included.

chart.note: Sample assumptions allocate AED 600,000; other costs and the original purchase price are excluded.

sections.heading: Prepare for a tenanted sale
sections.body:
If the apartment is rented, give the prospective buyer accurate information about the existing lease, payment history and deposit arrangements. Check what access can be agreed for viewings and avoid promising that the tenant will leave on a particular date without confirming the applicable rights and written terms.

Discuss with the buyer how rent already paid for a period after transfer and the tenant's deposit will be accounted for. Record any agreed adjustment in the sale documents and obtain suitable legal advice where necessary. Keep a clear handover record so the buyer knows the management contact, repair history and documents associated with the property.

sections.heading: Discuss the next step
sections.body:
Review the [Aliyas Ajman project collection](/projects?emirate=Ajman) for local property context, and [contact Aliyas](/contact) with your apartment details and preferred sale timing. Ask for a current market assessment and written service terms.

Confirm the final documents, charges and transfer procedure with the relevant department, developer and lender for the unit you are selling.
